I am writing to file a formal complaint regarding an online part-time job scam that I fell victim to. I am Routhu Prudhvi, a student currently studying at Vellore Institute of Technology, Amaravathi, Andhra Pradesh. The purpose of this complaint is to bring to your attention the fraudulent activities of a group that operates through Instagram and WhatsApp, deceiving individuals by promising lucrative earnings.


On 14-08-23 , I came across an advertisement on Instagram promoting a part-time job opportunity. The ad claimed that participants could earn between 3000 to 5000 rupees per day. Intrigued by the opportunity, I clicked on the ad, which redirected me to a WhatsApp number. The person on the other end instructed me to visit a website named E Best Amo Mall using a link. I was required to use the invitation code pgmcg during registration.

Upon visiting the website, I was prompted to complete an order using my own money. The promise was that I would receive 200 rupees within 6-8 hours as a reward. Once the transaction was completed, I was connected to a mentor through Telegram using this link provided on WhatsApp: https://t.me/Janinea7 (https://t.me/Janinea7).
